title: CWP/16424/2024 of DEVENDER KUMAR AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:

State of Haryana and Others ..Respondent(s) CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV PRAKASH SHARMA HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE H.S. GREWAL Present: None for the petitioner(s). Mr. Pravindra Singh Chauhan, Senior Advocate (Advocate General, Haryana ) with Mr. Navneet Singh, Advocate for the respondent (s). SANJEEV PRAKASH SHARMA, J.(ORAL) For order, see detailed judgment of even date passed in CWP No.14627 of 2024 titled as “MAHABIR SINGH TANWAR V/S STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS.” (SANJEEV PRAKASH SHARMA) JUDGE (H.S. GREWAL) JUDGE 24.04.2025 Poonam Sharma

1. Whether speaking/reasoned? Yes/No

2. Whether reportable? Yes/No
